input_format: raw sequence of HTTP/2 wire frames
configuration_profile: real RST_STREAM handler with a fresh nginx pool, minimal HTTP/2 server configuration, two synthetic live streams and one indexed closed node
allocator_mode: NGX_DEBUG_PALLOC=1 with a fresh nginx pool for each fragmentation replay
justification: NGX-IF11 frame dispatch and NGX-IF12 connection control coverage do not exercise the active-stream reset and request-connection error state machine.
state: Each input is parsed four times with identical bytes: contiguously, byte-by-byte, in three-byte fragments and with an input-selected fragment size.
known_limitations: Only RST_STREAM and NGX-IF12 connection control frames are accepted by the shared isolated driver.
Stream IDs 1 and 5 have synthetic request connections, while ID 3 is indexed as closed; the complete request and stream lifecycle is not entered.
The event callback records ready state and performs no request processing.
The synthetic connection driver is applied only to the isolated instrumented build copy.

scopes.contract: Validate RST_STREAM length and nonzero stream identifier, ignore unknown/closed streams and mark a live stream and its request connection closed/error before notifying its read event.
scopes.preconditions: Fresh HTTP/2 connection, live streams at IDs 1 and 5, indexed closed node ID 3, valid request connections and no-op read event callbacks.
